name: Adela Schuster
bio: A friend of Wilde's of the Tite Street years, known in the circle as 'Miss Tiny'. Two of Wilde's letters to her survive, both from December 1894. She is remembered chiefly for what she did the following spring: she gave Wilde £1,000 before the trials, at a point when almost nobody would be seen helping him.
bio_note: The volume's Index of Recipients. Two letters at printed 621 and 625. Dates not recorded and none inferred.
